question: In which country is the largest natural hot spring, 'Frying Pan Lake', located?
solution:
The correct answer is__** New Zealand.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Frying Pan Lake** is located in** Wai-O-Tapu**, a geothermal area near **Rotorua **on the North Island of **New Zealand**.
 
• It is recognized as **the largest natural hot spring** in the world, with a surface temperature that can reach up to **74°C (165°F).**
 
• The lake is known for its stunning **blue-green color**, which is caused by the presence of dissolved minerals, primarily silica.
 
• Frying Pan Lake is a significant attraction for tourists, showcasing the geothermal activity and unique landscapes of the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geothermal Features**: The area around Frying Pan Lake is known for its geothermal features, including **hot springs, mud pools, and fumaroles.**
 
• **Tourism**: The lake and its surroundings are part of the **Wai-O-Tapu Thermal Wonderland**, attracting thousands of visitors interested in natural wonders and geothermal phenomena.
 
• **Ecological Significance**: The high temperatures and unique chemical composition create a distinctive environment that supports specialized microbial life.
 
• **Historical Context**: The Maori people have inhabited the region for centuries, and the geothermal features are integral to their culture and traditions.
